# Throughput with AMD_CPU_AFFINITY=0: the HIP runtime otherwise pins every process that initialises
# it (accelerate launch, the ranks, their DataLoader workers) to 8 of the node's 160 CPUs.
aff0-act-1g|act-base|0|1|--batch_size=32 --steps=60 --log_freq=20 --save_freq=100000 --num_workers=8 --dataset.episodes=null|export AMD_CPU_AFFINITY=0;;python3 -c "import os, torch; torch.cuda.device_count(); print('AFFINITY_AFTER_HIP_INIT', len(os.sched_getaffinity(0)))";;export MIOPEN_USER_DB_PATH=/outputs/rocm-train/miopen/fast/db;;export MIOPEN_CUSTOM_CACHE_DIR=/outputs/rocm-train/miopen/fast/cache
